method.source: Fresh TypeScript AST traversal from renderer main.tsx resolves relative TS/TSX imports, includes native interactive tags, interactive roles and explicit tabIndex targets. All35 family hashes/counts match current family evidence map. Inspect source names, native semantics and custom keyboard handlers against selected native records.
method.native: Reuse dated native CUA app interactions and screenshots/accessibility projections in selected records, with later corrections superseding specific earlier failures. No fresh native run, build or lint is needed for this documentation-only audit. Current production code is the verified PR108 tree.
method.composition: Native shared-control behavior can establish unchanged callers when their differences are resource endpoint/label/active mode rather than DOM or focus handling. Preserve each evidence record limits; a source count or link alone is not proof.
